text.body: varṇaśikṣā varṇānāṃ strīpuṃnapuṃsakasaṃjñā kakāraṃ ca gakāraṃ ca cakāraṃ ca jakārakam ṭakāraṃ ca ḍakāraṃ ca takāraṃ ca dakārakam 1 pakāraṃ ca bakāraṃ ca ṣakāraṃ ca kṣakārakam ete dvādaśavarṇā syuḥ puṃlligāśceti kīrtitāḥ 2 khakāraṃ ca ghakāraṃ ca chakāraṃ ca jhakārakam ṭhakāraṃ ca ḍhakāraṃ ca thakāraṃ ca dhakārakam 3 phakāraṃ ca bhakāraṃ ca śakāraṃ ca sakārakam ete vai bhānubījāni jāyāśceti prakīrtitāḥ 4 śeṣaṃ napuṃsakaṃ jñeyaṃ trayo bhedā iti smṛtāḥ śivāgnibhūtarudrāśca trayodaśa tithistathā 5 ete vai svaravarṇā syuḥ puṃlliṅgāśceti kīrtitāḥ pakṣo vedarasā bhānurmanuśaivādhikārakāḥ 6 etāni svaravarṇāni strīliṅgānīti kīrtyate prakṛtiḥ saptavarṇāni vikṛtistu navārṇakam 7 prakṛtirhrasvamityuktaṃ vikṛtirdīrghamucyate prathamāśca tṛtīyāśca ṣakāraśca kṣakārakam 8 ete dvādaśavarṇā syuḥ puṃlliṅgāśceti kīrtitāḥ dvitīyāśca caturthāśca śasakārau tathaiva ca 9 ete dvādaśavarṇā syustrīlliṅgāśceti prakīrtitāḥ varṇānāṃ satvarajastamo guṇāḥ antasthāścottamāścaiva ṛ lṛ varṇau tathaiva ca 10 hakāraśca lakāraśca klībāśceti prakīrtitāḥ pakṣo gṛhārthasaṃkhyā ca trayodaśamanustathā 11 ete vai sātvikaguṇāḥ śvetavarṇaṃ tathaiva ca śivābdhisaptāvasudikca rudrāḥ tithiścaiva kalāstathā 12 ete vai rājasaguṇā raktavarṇaṃ tathaiva ca bāṇo rasastṛtīyā ca śyāmavarṇaṃ tamo guṇaḥ 13 hal dvitīyā ca caturthaśca tavargaprathamottamau pavargaprathamaścaiva vedāṣṭādaśa eva ca 14 ete vai sātvikaguṇā śvetavarṇaṃ tathaiva ca khakāraṃ ca ghakāraṃ ca ṭhakāraṃ ca thakārakam 15 takāraṃ ca nakāraṃ ca pakāraṃ ca phakārakam vakāraṃ ca hakāraśca kṣakāraṃ ceti sātvikaḥ 16 kavargaprathamaścaiva ṭavargaśca tathaiva ca tṛtīyāśca tapavargacaturthāśca caṭavargottamau tathā 17 ūṣmāṇaścaiva rephaśca lalakārau rajoguṇāḥ kavargaprathamaścaiva ṭavargaśca tathaiva ca 18 tṛtīyāśca bhakāraśca dhakāraṃ ca ñakārakam ṇakāraṃ coṣmaṇaścaiva rephaścaiva lalau tathā 19 ete rajoguṇāḥ proktā raktavarṇaṃ tathaiva ca cakāraśca dvitīyā ca ṅakāraṃ ca makārakam 20 ḍhakāraṃ ca dakāraṃ ca yakāraṃ ca jhakārakam tāmasaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca uttamaśca miśrakam 21 cakāraśca dvitīyā ca ādyantau vargapañcamau caṭavargacaturthau ca tavargaśca tṛtīyakam 22 yakārasāmasaguṇaśyāmavarṇastathaiva ca 23 akāraṃ sarvadaivatyaṃ raktavarṇaṃ rajasmṛtam ākārasyātparāśakti śvetaṃ sātvikamucyate 24 ikāraṃ viṣṇudaivatyaṃ śyāmaṃ tāmasamucyate māyāśaktiritīkāraṃ pītaṃ rājasamucyate 25 ukāraṃ vāstudaivatyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tāmasamīritam ūkāraṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ śyāmalaṃ tāmasaṃ bhavet 26 ṛkāraṃ brahmaṇo jñeyaṃ pītaṃ rājasamucyate śikhaṇḍirūpaṃ ṝkāraṃ rājasaṃ pītavarṇakam 27 aśvinau tu lṛ lṝ proktau ekāraṃ vīrabhadraṃ syāt rajaḥ pītaṃ tu siddhidam 28 aikāraṃ vāgbhavaṃ vindyā okāramīśvaraṃ viṃdyājjyotiḥ satvaṃ phalapradam 29 aukāramādiśakti syācchuklaṃ sarvatra siddhidam aṃkāraṃ tu maheśaṃ syādraktavarṇaṃ tu rājasam 30 aḥ kāraṃ kālarudraṃ ca raktaṃ rājasamucyate prājāpatyaṃ kakāraṃ syātpītaṃ vṛṣṭipradaṃ rajaḥ 31 khakāraṃ jāhnavībījaṃ kṣīrābhaṃ pāpanāśanam gaṇāpatyaṃ gakāraṃ syādraktābhaṃ vighnanāśanam 32 ghakāraṃ bhairavaṃ jñeyaṃ muktābhaṃ śatrunāśanam ṅakāraṃ kālabījaṃ syātkālaṃ tārkṣyaṃ samucyate 33 cakāraṃ caṇḍarudraṃ syāt añjanābhaṃ tu tāmasam chakāraṃ bhadrakālī syāttāmasaṃ parikīrtitam 34 jakāraṃ jambhahā jñeyaṃ raktābhaṃ ca jayāvaham jhakāramardhanārīśaṃ śyāmaraktaṃ tu miśrakam 35 ñakāraṃ sarpadaivatyaṃ pītaṃ rājasarūpakam bhṛṅgīśaṃ syāṭṭakāraṃ tu raktaṃ rājasameva ca 36 ṭhakāraṃ candrabījaṃ syācchvetaṃ sātvikamucyate ḍakāraṃ caikanetraṃ syātpītaṃ rājasamucyate 37 ḍhakāraṃ yamabījaṃ syānnīlaṃ mṛtyuvināśanam ṇakāraṃ nandibījaṃ syādraktābhaṃ cārthasiddhidam 38 takāraṃ vāstudaivatyaṃ śvetaṃ thakāraṃ brahmaṇo jñeyaṃ durgābījaṃ dakāraṃ syācchyāmaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam 39 dhakāraṃ dhanadaṃ proktaṃ pītābhaṃ cārthasiddhidam nakāraṃ caiva sāvitrī sphāṭikaṃ pāpanāśanam 40 pakāraṃ caiva parjanyaṃ śuklābhaṃ vṛṣṭisiddhidam phakāraṃ pāśupatyaṃ ca satvaḥ pāpavināśanam 41 bakāraṃ tu trimūrti syātpītaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam bhakāraṃ bhārgavaṃ vindyādraktaṃ bhāgyapradaṃ bhavet 42 makāraṃ madanaṃ vindyācchyāmaṃ kāmaphalapradam yakāraṃ vāyudaivatyaṃ kṛṣṇamuccāṭanaṃ bhavet 43 rakāraṃ vahnidaivatyaṃ raktābhaṃ rājasaṃ bhavet lakāraṃ pṛthivībījaṃ pītaṃ syāt lambhanaṃ bhavet 44 vakāraṃ vāruṇaṃ bījaṃ śuklābhaṃ yoganāśanam lakṣmībījaṃ śakāraṃ syāt hemābhaṃ rājasaṃ bhavet 45 ṣakāraṃ dvādaśātmaṃ syāt raktābhaṃ tu jayapradam sakāraṃ śaktibījaṃ syādraktaṃ sthitikaraṃ bhavet 46 hakāraṃ śivabījaṃ syācchuddhasphaṭikasannibham aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhaṃ ca bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayacchati 47 lakāraṃ cātmabījaṃ syāt raktābhaṃ sarvasiddhidam 48 iti varṇaśikṣā samāptā
